name: get_jobs
description: Find jobs by what the caller said they want. Pass their role or interest as English words (e.g. "data entry operator", "electrician", "security guard", "tailoring") - translate what they said in Kannada into English before sending, and send the WORK they want, not a place. Use this when the caller names a role, asks for something different from what their profile says, or has no profile. For a caller with a profile who has not named a role, use get_recommended_jobs instead. Returns message.items[]: item_id (the job_id to apply with), score, and item_state with role, jobProviderName (the company), positions, salaryMin/salaryMax when present. jobProviderLocation is masked on this instance - never speak it. An empty items[] means we genuinely have nothing in that role: say so plainly and never invent one.

query.description: The role or kind of work the caller wants, in ENGLISH words. Translate their Kannada into English first ("ಡೇಟಾ ಎಂಟ್ರಿ" -> "data entry operator", "ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಕೆಲಸ" -> "electrician", "ಮೆಕ್ಯಾನಿಕ್" -> "mechanic"). Words only - no place names, no salary, no punctuation.
